verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents sending custom track events tied to identified people through the Track API, Pipelines API, and SDKs (docs-7, docs-3, docs-5). Its automations can be triggered when a profile performs an event (docs-12), and the trigger is a core automation component (docs-55), so firing an event from your product starts an automation for that person. Missing for 10: explicit docs on configuring an event-triggered automation (event matching, using event data in messages), and independent hands-on corroboration of the event-to-automation flow.
